retrievalProfile.description: A full-body male portrait set against a high-contrast, crumpled paper background with large-scale, stacked condensed typography.
excludeWhen: soft or pastel color palettes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A full-length portrait of a man in dark clothing positioned on the left, balanced by heavy, right-aligned stacked typography. The entire scene is unified by a distressed, wrinkled paper texture with visible creases and subtle ink smudges.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject-to-background integration via shared texture and grain
Typographic weight balancing the visual mass of the subject
Vertical division between the clean subject area and the textured text area
coreInvariants: Crumpled paper texture overlaying all elements
High-contrast monochromatic or desaturated color scheme

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body figure standing on the left third, scaled to nearly the full height of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large-scale display text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down the body, then sweeps across to the large text block on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Utilized as a textured canvas rather than empty space, providing breathing room between the subject and the text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for subject clothing and secondary text
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high tonal contrast between light background and dark subject.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Ampersand styled to match the condensed weight of the letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and colors of the same condensed sans-serif family.
graphicDevices: Vertical seam or fold line separating the image into two halves

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel for the display text.
Offers a variety of condensed weights suitable for the hierarchy.
Classic condensed sans-serif that matches the urban aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a full-body portrait of a man in a black t-shirt and black jeans standing against a light grey background with heavy crumpled paper textures, creases, and subtle distressed ink marks.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned, stacked, extra-condensed sans-serif text on the right side. Use white for the top block and black for the bottom block. Apply a subtle weathered texture to the text to match the background.

verificationChecks: Is the paper texture visible across both the subject and the background?
Is the text right-aligned and stacked vertically?
Is there a clear tonal contrast between the white and black text blocks?
Does the subject occupy the left third of the frame?

mustRedesign: Transcribed artist names or song titles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the texture doesn't obscure the subject's face.
Check that the text is legible despite the distress effects.
Verify the right-alignment of all text blocks.
recipe.reuseFormula: Full-body subject on left + Crumpled paper texture + Right-aligned stacked condensed sans-serif typography.
